frozenQuestion.objective: Repeat the unchanged 114-state sample-31 matrix, retain one complete live operand record in every state, independently capture and decode both owner-region handles and their bounded prefixes, and preserve bounded provenance for each eligible callback that cannot produce complete operands.
frozenQuestion.selectionRule: An operand may be accepted only on vertex-buffer index 1 for fragment A2Xghfc or TimgA2Xhfc_Isrc when _Unwind_Backtrace finds the exact capture_backdrop symbol at return offset 0x2b58. Merely observing either fragment, matching geometry, or finding a later same-state repeat is insufficient.
frozenQuestion.alternateProducerRule: TimgA2Xhfc_Isrc is added because the failed x=-4 state selected that Apple producer. It receives no fallback authority: the same exact symbol, PC, frame, complete-read, rectangle, region, and primary-word gates apply.
frozenQuestion.memoryRule: After the existing byte-gated stack and object reads, retain exactly 256 checked same-task bytes for an even nonzero selected handle. For each even nonzero owner+0x248 and owner+0x270 handle, require the first 256 checked bytes and continue in checked 256-byte chunks up to 4096 bytes; retain the exact successful length. Independently require the 256-byte owner window at offsets 0x200..0x2ff and verify its embedded +0x248 and +0x270 words against the separate handle reads. Immediate odd or null region handles retain zero pointee bytes. Each checked chunk may be attempted at most three times and a missing required read fails closed.
frozenQuestion.callbackRule: Before a complete operand capture, retain at most eight eligible callback diagnostics per record. Each diagnostic contains at most 32 symbolized frames and symbol-relative offsets, no raw stack memory, and an optional incomplete operand read mask. Diagnostics cannot count as operands or satisfy any replay gate.
frozenQuestion.matrixRule: Keep geometry, material, appearance, direction, source sample, 114 interventions, public requested layer states, filter inputs, original producer input, retry policy, and buffer-retention policy unchanged from the failed selected-region run.
frozenQuestion.replayRule: Require the selected region to equal owner+0x248 in all 114 states, decode the first rectangle of both owner regions through the pinned ShapeIterator implementation, require the selected consumed rectangle to equal SP+0x280, and replay every primary position and source component by binary32 bit pattern.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: A missing live operand, partial required read mask, wrong fragment or PC, changed code prefix, undecodable owner prefix, selected/owner+0x248 mismatch, wrong owner class count, rectangle mismatch, or one differing position/source bit fails the workflow and remains evidence.
